answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow effectively thwarts Sybil attacks via four distinct steps. First, every agent must lock $75,000 in a smart contract. Second, validator nodes verify unique hardware enclaves. Third, any detected identity duplication triggers an automated bond burn. Fourth, the offending agent's reputation is permanently erased. For an attacker, the cost is $7,500,000 in bonds and 120 days of deep forensic audits. This mechanism acts like a crystal vault protecting a rare relic, ensuring every single pearl of truth remains secure against any fraud.
